tr.title: much ve many farkı nedir?
tr.metaDesc: much vs many farkı: ne zaman much, ne zaman many? Sayılabilen/sayılamayan, örneklerle — LinguaBattle.
tr.lede: much ve many ikisi de “çok” demektir ama farklı isimlerle kullanılır: many sayılabilen (çoğul), much sayılamayan isimlerle.

means.en: many books, many people
much water, much time
How many cars? How much money?

means.def: a lot of = ikisinde de güvenli
means.en: a lot of books / a lot of water
means.t: çok kitap / çok su (ikisinde de olur)

en.title: Much vs many: what's the difference?
en.metaDesc: Much vs many difference: when to use much or many? Countable/uncountable, with examples — LinguaBattle.
en.lede: much and many both mean “a lot”, but go with different nouns: many with countable (plural), much with uncountable nouns.

means.en: many books, many people
much water, much time

means.def: Tip: if you can count it → many
means.en: How many cars? How much money?

means.def: a lot of = safe with both
means.en: a lot of books / a lot of water

de.title: Much vs many: Was ist der Unterschied?
de.metaDesc: Unterschied much vs many: Wann much oder many? Zählbar/unzählbar, mit Beispielen — LinguaBattle.
de.lede: much und many bedeuten beide „viel“, stehen aber mit verschiedenen Nomen: many mit zählbaren (Plural), much mit unzählbaren Nomen.

means.en: many books, many people
much water, much time
How many cars? How much money?

means.def: a lot of = bei beiden sicher
means.en: a lot of books / a lot of water

fr.title: Much vs many : quelle différence ?
fr.metaDesc: Différence much vs many : quand utiliser much ou many ? Dénombrable/indénombrable, exemples — LinguaBattle.
fr.lede: much et many signifient tous deux « beaucoup », mais avec des noms différents : many avec les dénombrables (pluriel), much avec les indénombrables.

means.en: many books, many people
much water, much time

means.def: Astuce : si ça se compte → many
means.en: How many cars? How much money?

means.def: a lot of = sûr pour les deux
means.en: a lot of books / a lot of water

es.title: Much vs many: ¿cuál es la diferencia?
es.metaDesc: Diferencia much vs many: ¿cuándo usar much o many? Contable/incontable, con ejemplos — LinguaBattle.
es.lede: much y many significan «mucho», pero van con sustantivos distintos: many con contables (plural), much con incontables.

means.en: many books, many people
much water, much time
How many cars? How much money?

means.def: a lot of = seguro con ambos
means.en: a lot of books / a lot of water

ar.title: ما الفرق بين much و many؟
ar.metaDesc: الفرق بين much وmany: متى نستخدم much أو many؟ معدود/غير معدود، أمثلة — LinguaBattle.
ar.lede: much وmany كلاهما يعني «كثير»، لكن مع أسماء مختلفة: many مع المعدود (الجمع)، much مع غير المعدود.

means.en: many books, many people
much water, much time
How many cars? How much money?

means.def: a lot of = آمنة مع الاثنين
means.en: a lot of books / a lot of water

hi.metaDesc: much बनाम many अंतर: कब much, कब many? गणनीय/अगणनीय, उदाहरण सहित — LinguaBattle.
hi.lede: much और many दोनों का मतलब “बहुत” है, पर अलग संज्ञाओं के साथ: many गणनीय (बहुवचन), much अगणनीय संज्ञाओं के साथ।

means.en: many books, many people
much water, much time
How many cars? How much money?

means.def: a lot of = दोनों के साथ सुरक्षित
means.en: a lot of books / a lot of water

ru.metaDesc: Разница much vs many: когда much, когда many? Исчисляемое/неисчисляемое, примеры — LinguaBattle.
ru.lede: much и many оба значат «много», но с разными существительными: many с исчисляемыми (мн.ч.), much с неисчисляемыми.

means.en: many books, many people
much water, much time
How many cars? How much money?

means.def: a lot of = безопасно с обоими

pt.title: Much vs many: qual é a diferença?
pt.metaDesc: Diferença much vs many: quando usar much ou many? Contável/incontável, com exemplos — LinguaBattle.
pt.lede: much e many significam «muito», mas vão com substantivos diferentes: many com contáveis (plural), much com incontáveis.

means.en: many books, many people
much water, much time

means.def: Dica: se dá para contar → many
means.en: How many cars? How much money?

ja.title: much と many の違いは？
ja.metaDesc: much と many の違い：いつ much、いつ many？可算/不可算、例文付き — LinguaBattle.
ja.lede: much と many はどちらも「たくさん」だが、付く名詞が違う：many は可算名詞（複数）、much は不可算名詞。

means.en: many books, many people
much water, much time

means.def: コツ：数えられるなら → many
means.en: How many cars? How much money?

means.def: a lot of = どちらでも安全
means.en: a lot of books / a lot of water
